elements.name: signature

properties.description: The name of the step, always visible.
Where the step is in the flow; at most one step can be `current`.
Supporting detail under the title; on an error step it is the error text.

steps.description: The steps of the flow in order.

showDetails.description: Whether the description of the named step is visible when it isn't in error.

stepCountLabel.description: Returns the position text of the named step.

compactErrorLabel.description: Returns the screen reader text that names a failed step.

themeOverride.description: The theme override of the Stepper, which owns the compact tokens.
